method: Expected Box Entry (xBE): HistGradientBoostingClassifier predicting P(open-play pass into the penalty box succeeds) from pre-pass trajectory features. Alternative to xA -- values the pass itself (reaching the box) rather than the receiver's shot quality. Not a zone-transition (xT) or state-value (VAEP/EPV) framework.
universe: Open-play passes (typeId 1) starting outside the box (x<83 or y outside [21.1, 78.9]) with intended end point (qualifiers 140/141) inside the box. Excludes free kicks/corners/throw-ins (qualifiers 5, 6, 107, 160).
